pages.text: $(bold)Tier 4 reached.$() This is the top of the ladder, with no token gate past it.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Dimensions:$() the Aether (Deep Aether's biomes included) and, beyond it, the End.$(li)$(bold)Tech:$() advanced Mekanism, RFTools Dimensions.$(li)$(bold)Magic:$() Mahou Tsukai.$(li)$(bold)Gear:$() Netherite, Gaia, Antimatter, Atomic Alloy.

pages.title: The Finale
pages.text: Eyes of Ender lead you to the End (see $(l:icraft:progression/dimensions)Dimensional Progression$(/l)). Defeat the $(t4)Ender Dragon$() to win. The Ad Astra planets are open to you now too; you reach them by rocket, without killing the dragon first.$(br2)Your surplus tokens also have a new use: the $(l:icraft:progression/token_exchange)Token Exchange$(/l) turns them into experience.
